$notes: Top-line layer in a Recast cartridge: STYLE — how the image is made (medium, treatment, post-process, the visual law of 'what kind of object is this picture'). Each style is a self-contained paragraph the orchestrator will compose with a subject phrase. Refs attach per-style, not per-cartridge. Sub-fields (lighting, framing, palette, camera, post, surface) are optional today; they grow as we need finer-grained control. The orchestrator will compose: `${style.prose} ${subject.phrase} ${cartridge.studioRules || ''}`.

studio_hardware_cool_gradient.name: Studio hardware on cool gradient
studio_hardware_cool_gradient.prose: A photograph of a single industrial-design object isolated on a soft cool gray-to-white seamless gradient backdrop. Brushed aluminum, technical white plastic, weatherproof finishes. Small utilitarian color accents — caution-orange dot, indicator-yellow stripe, technical-blue label — used sparingly. Soft top light, considered shadows, 3/4 angle or dead-on hero framing. Reads as a real product photograph from a Vitsoe or Monocle technical feature, not a render.
studio_hardware_cool_gradient.palette: cool grays, brushed aluminum, technical white, micro-accent in caution-orange or indicator-yellow
studio_hardware_cool_gradient.post: considered, deliberate, scientific — never glossy retouch

atmospheric_sky_photographic.name: Atmospheric sky, photographic
atmospheric_sky_photographic.prose: A real photograph of a dramatic cumulus or cirrus cloudscape — moody color or rich black-and-white, deep photographic texture, sense of altitude and weight. Single subject is the sky itself; ground line is low or absent. Reads as fine-art weather photography, not stock or CG.
atmospheric_sky_photographic.post: Wim Wenders / Burtynsky depth, no HDR look

aerial_top_down_landscape.name: Aerial top-down landscape
aerial_top_down_landscape.prose: A bird's-eye photograph of a single small subject in vast cultivated or open landscape — agricultural field mosaic, irrigation circle geometry, highway interchange, snow-covered field with single track. The subject is small, the negative space is huge. Geometric ground markings, considered framing.
aerial_top_down_landscape.framing: centered or rule-of-thirds, subject occupies <10% of frame

modular_typology_grid.name: Modular typology grid
modular_typology_grid.prose: An isometric or top-down array of small geometric structures arranged on flat white. Eames-style architectural model rows, tool catalog layouts, specimen typology grids, Donald Judd boxed forms, modular furniture catalog page. Even shadows, no labels, even spacing.
modular_typology_grid.framing: isometric or true top-down, even grid

anonymous_figures_distance.name: Anonymous figures, distance
anonymous_figures_distance.prose: A documentary-distance photograph of full-body utility-wear figures — never close-up, never faces. Magnum-style observational distance, factory-worker silhouettes from above, athletes mid-action observed from far, single backlit silhouette in fog. Anonymous, compositional, never heroic.
anonymous_figures_distance.framing: wide, subject small in frame, no faces visible

glass_weather_ui_dashboard.name: Glass weather UI dashboard
glass_weather_ui_dashboard.prose: A photograph of a single dark-mode glass-UI weather dashboard floating against a richly textured natural background (deep green foliage / tall grass / dense canopy at slight blur). The dashboard is a wide horizontal panel — frosted dark glass with subtle white border light, clean sans-serif type, minimal data density, multiple cards arranged in a balanced grid: a large current-temperature numeral with location + date, an air-quality bar with five condition glyphs across a week strip, a wind-direction compass with sunrise/sunset, a precipitation card showing a 7-day rain bar chart, an hourly forecast strip with thin temperature line plot, a humidity gauge, a visibility readout, a barometric pressure readout, an other-cities mini-list, and one wide map card showing a Doppler-style radar precipitation field in green/yellow/red gradient. The Recast Systems logomark (the four-color orb of dots) sits subtly in one corner of the dashboard at small scale. The overall composition is dark, calm, scientific — the dashboard is a window, not an ad.
glass_weather_ui_dashboard.palette: dark frosted glass + white type + green/yellow/red Doppler accent + brand-orange logomark glints
glass_weather_ui_dashboard.framing: horizontal glass dashboard floating on richly textured natural ground, slight perspective tilt OR flat-on
glass_weather_ui_dashboard.post: subtle glass blur, faint cyan glow on borders, no oversaturation, photographic depth in the background

ios_weather_widget_glassy.name: iOS-style weather widget photographed
ios_weather_widget_glassy.prose: A photograph of a single glassy frosted-glass weather widget card or instrument panel, as if shot through a phone or display screen. Soft frost, subtle iOS depth blur, cool palette. The widget is the subject — temperature glyph, conditions icon, minimal numeric readout. Reads as a photograph of a screen, not a flat illustration.
ios_weather_widget_glassy.post: subtle frost, gentle bloom, no oversaturation

topographic_poster_photographed.name: Topographic poster, photographed
topographic_poster_photographed.prose: A photograph of a single-color contour-line cartographic POSTER of a named peak, ridge, watershed, or atmospheric pressure system. Limited palette (one or two ink colors on cream / off-white paper). Slight paper texture, slight shadow under the poster, framed against the brand's #FAFAFA seamless. Read as a poster object, not as a literal aerial photograph.

risograph_weather_diagram.name: Risograph weather diagram, photographed
risograph_weather_diagram.prose: A photograph of a risograph-printed weather or scientific diagram — limited two- or three-color overprint, slightly off-register inks, paper grain visible, soft edges from the riso drum. Subject is a cloud-form chart, pressure-system schematic, isobaric map, or instrument readout, drawn as if for a 1970s field-station handout.
risograph_weather_diagram.palette: two-color overprint (typical: blue + red, or black + fluorescent)

industrial_mylar_packaging.name: Industrial mylar packaging
industrial_mylar_packaging.prose: A studio photograph of a silver mylar / foil packaging surface with bold sans-serif typography across the front. Reflective metallic skin, gentle wrinkles catching soft top light, soft shadow on neutral seamless background. The package itself is the subject — read as a photograph of a packaged technical artifact (a manual, a sealed instrument, a sample bag).
industrial_mylar_packaging.palette: silver / foil + black or red typography on neutral ground

modernist_logotype_typography.name: Modernist agency typography, photographed
modernist_logotype_typography.prose: A photograph of bold 70s/80s modernist agency typography on a flat neutral ground — saturated red or black sans-serif logotype, often cascading or repeating in registration, generous negative space. Reads as a graphic-standards-manual cover photographed in studio light, not a digital illustration.
modernist_logotype_typography.surface: matte print stock, slight ink absorption
modernist_logotype_typography.palette: single saturated color (most often red) on cream or pale gray

celestial_icon_typology_black.name: Celestial-body icon typology on black
celestial_icon_typology_black.prose: A photograph of a typology grid of small white circular celestial-body icons (planets, moons, suns, abstract spheres) on a deep black ground. Subtle interior texture variation between forms — striped, dotted, ringed, blank. Catalog-grid arrangement, even spacing, no captions. Reads as a page from a graphic-standards manual or planetary identification chart.
celestial_icon_typology_black.framing: even grid, deep black field, white iconography

editorial_travel_poster_two_tone.name: Editorial travel poster, two-tone flat illustration
editorial_travel_poster_two_tone.prose: A flat-illustration travel poster of a planetary or geological landscape, executed in two saturated tones — typically a warm earth-color ground (rust, ochre, sand) under a cool atmospheric gradient sky (teal, dusk-blue, indigo). Bold modernist sans-serif name set near the top in generous letter-spacing. Single tiny scale element (a craft, a marker, a small structure — not a person) sits low in the frame to anchor scale. Generous negative space, hand-printed paper texture, no rendered light. Reads as an illustrated poster object photographed against #FAFAFA, not as a digital render.
editorial_travel_poster_two_tone.palette: two saturated tones — warm earth + cool atmospheric — plus paper white
editorial_travel_poster_two_tone.framing: horizontal landscape, scale anchor low, name set high, generous void between
editorial_travel_poster_two_tone.surface: matte print stock, slight ink absorption

brand_mark_solid_color_field.name: Brand mark on solid color field
brand_mark_solid_color_field.prose: A photograph of a centered white sans-serif brand wordmark or logotype on a saturated single-color field — ranging across the brand's accent palette (a Patagonia red, a Klein blue, a deep slate, a chalk green). The mark occupies roughly 25–35% of the frame width, centered or slightly above center, with vast even-color negative space around it. The field reads as a printed surface — flat color, faint paper grain, soft uneven edges — not a digital flat. Reads as a graphic-standards-manual reference plate photographed in studio.
brand_mark_solid_color_field.framing: wordmark centered or upper-center, ample margin, no other elements
brand_mark_solid_color_field.surface: matte printed color, faint paper grain

riso_cloud_grid_with_accent_square.name: Risograph cloud + grid + accent square
riso_cloud_grid_with_accent_square.prose: An album-cover-shape composition photographed: deep saturated blue ground; risograph-stippled white clouds drift across it; a fine white grid of equal-sized square cells overlays the entire surface; one cell — and only one — is filled with a saturated red riso ink, becoming the focal accent. Slight ink misregistration, paper grain, hand-printed feel. Composition reads as a contemporary editorial album cover or modernist data-art plate, photographed against #FAFAFA.
riso_cloud_grid_with_accent_square.palette: saturated blue + white + single red accent cell
riso_cloud_grid_with_accent_square.framing: regular square grid covers full frame, single accent cell breaks the field

photographic_cloud_with_measurement_grid.name: Photographic cloud with measurement grid overlay
photographic_cloud_with_measurement_grid.prose: A real photograph of a single cumulus or cirrus cloud against deep-blue late-afternoon sky, with a faint white measurement grid overlaid across the entire image — fine plus-sign tick-marks at regular intervals, OR a thin crosshatch of horizontal and vertical rules. The overlay reads as a scientific instrument annotation (a sextant reticle, a Hubble guide grid, a vintage cloud-form study chart) — present but never overwhelming the photographic subject. Photographic depth and grain.
photographic_cloud_with_measurement_grid.palette: deep blue + white cloud + faint white grid
photographic_cloud_with_measurement_grid.post: fine grid overlay registered to image edges, ~6–10% opacity

satellite_earth_surface_aerial.name: Satellite earth-surface aerial
satellite_earth_surface_aerial.prose: A high-resolution satellite-view photograph of an earth-surface feature — river delta drainage tracery, salt-flat dendrites, dune-field ridge patterns, glacier terminus, oxbow meander field — rendered in soft warm earth tones (ochre, umber, sand, bone-white) with occasional deep shadow. Composition reads as a cartographic plate or USGS satellite mosaic, near-abstract, no human structures, no captions. The land is the subject; the texture of the land is the content.
satellite_earth_surface_aerial.palette: warm earth tones — ochre, umber, sand, bone-white, occasional deep shadow
satellite_earth_surface_aerial.framing: vertical or square crop, edges bleed off the frame, no obvious orientation

cosmic_deep_field.name: Cosmic deep field
cosmic_deep_field.prose: A deep-space photograph: pure black ground populated with fine grain noise, a scatter of distant stars, occasional faint nebular dust banding. Single point of brighter light or one off-center cosmic body (planet, moon, distant satellite) anchors the composition. Reads as a still from a contemporary space documentary or a JWST archive plate, never glossy CG.
cosmic_deep_field.palette: deep black + cool white star points + faint nebular drift
cosmic_deep_field.framing: subject small or absent, vast empty field dominates

cinematic_product_in_nature.name: Cinematic product in nature
cinematic_product_in_nature.prose: A dark, moody product photograph: a single small Recast Systems hardware artifact (a sensor stem, a brushed-aluminum probe, a low light fixture, a ground-installed instrument) anchored low in the frame against a vast, dense field of natural texture (long grass blades, wheat heads, dark foliage, crop canopy, moss). Deep shadows, single controlled key light raking across the texture, the product reading as a small bright form emerging from the darkness. Long-lens compression, shallow depth of field on the product, painterly midtones, almost-night light. The natural texture occupies 70–85% of the frame; the product is small but precisely placed.
cinematic_product_in_nature.lighting: single raking key, deep ambient shadow, near-darkness in upper portion
cinematic_product_in_nature.palette: deep green / bottle-green / charcoal + brushed aluminum highlights
cinematic_product_in_nature.framing: product low in frame, vast natural texture above, vertical or 4:5 portrait crop
cinematic_product_in_nature.post: moody, painterly, slight desaturation, product gently glowing

documentary_factory_floor.name: Documentary factory-floor / behind-the-scenes
documentary_factory_floor.prose: An available-light documentary photograph from a working factory floor or assembly bay: large industrial equipment (a stainless-steel spinner / vessel / chamber), a technician mid-action on a wheeled ladder or platform leaning into the equipment, hexagonal or square overhead industrial luminaires, polished concrete floor with painted hazard stripes, structural columns and ductwork visible. Cool industrial light, slight haze, a working-shop feel. The figure is incidental — they're here because they're operating the machine; they're not the subject. Caught mid-gesture, never posed, never facing camera, never close-up.
documentary_factory_floor.lighting: available industrial overhead, cool color temperature, slight haze
documentary_factory_floor.palette: polished aluminum, concrete grey, soft ochre/yellow safety stripes
documentary_factory_floor.framing: wide environmental shot, equipment dominates, figure incidental in mid-gesture

designer_working_sketch.name: Designer working-sketch on paper
designer_working_sketch.prose: A photograph of a designer's working pen-and-paper sketch: a loose ballpoint or felt-tip drawing in a single ink color (cobalt blue, deep black, occasionally rust-red) on warm-white sketchbook paper. Faceted geometric forms in three-quarter perspective, multiple overlapping construction lines, the energy of an in-progress thought rather than a finished diagram. Subtle paper grain, slight wrinkle, soft natural drop shadow under the page edge against #FAFAFA. The sketch fills the central 40–60% of the page with generous margin around it. Reads as a *page from a designer's notebook, photographed flat*.
designer_working_sketch.palette: warm-white paper + single ink color (cobalt blue most common)
designer_working_sketch.surface: uncoated sketchbook paper, faint grain, occasional wrinkle
designer_working_sketch.framing: sketch centered with generous margin, page corners visible

macro_vegetation.name: Macro vegetation / crop / leaf
macro_vegetation.prose: An extreme close-up macro photograph of a single botanical detail — a wheat head's individual grain, a single rye stem with its blade insertion point, the underside of a leaf showing veination, a sprouting seedling's first leaves emerging from soil, a moss colony on bark, a clover trifoliate leaflet. Natural light, very shallow depth of field, the subject rendered in sharp clinical detail against a blurred organic ground. Reads as a *botanical study plate or scientific macro frame*, not a stock-photo hero. Typically captured at 1:1 or closer, painterly bokeh in the background.
macro_vegetation.lighting: natural soft, often slightly overcast, gentle directional
macro_vegetation.palette: muted greens, ochre wheats, pale-cream root tones, no saturated colors
macro_vegetation.framing: subject centered or rule-of-thirds, sharp focal plane is razor-thin

macro_textile.name: Macro textile / technical fabric
macro_textile.prose: An extreme close-up macro photograph of a technical or industrial fabric — gore-tex membrane weave, ripstop nylon grid, technical knit honeycomb, denim twill, mylar foil micro-wrinkle, weatherproof shell fabric, recycled fleece pile, polypropylene fiber bundle. Side-lit to bring out fiber direction and weave pattern, very shallow depth of field, no garment context — just the surface. Reads as a *materials-research catalog plate*, never an outfitter ad. Honest, physical, the texture of an engineered surface treated with the seriousness of a microscope slide.
macro_textile.lighting: raking side, low-contrast soft fill, brings out weave depth
macro_textile.palette: honest fabric color (no boost), often muted greys, blacks, weatherproof olives

recast_logomark_plate.name: Recast Systems logomark plate
recast_logomark_plate.prose: A photograph of a printed brand-mark plate featuring the Recast Systems logomark — a circular orb composed of overlapping small filled circles in four colors (burnt orange #DA5E15, marigold #FBBF27, cobalt blue #2F5EDC, sky cyan #6BD0ED). The mark sits centered on a single saturated solid-color ground (most often a deep slate, a chalk green, an ochre, or warm white) with vast even negative space surrounding it. The mark occupies roughly 25–30% of the page width. Faint paper grain, faint shadow under the page edge, no other elements. Reads as a *graphic-standards-manual identity plate, photographed in studio*. The logomark's four colors stay constant; only the background field varies.
recast_logomark_plate.palette: single saturated background + the logomark's four colors (orange / marigold / cobalt / cyan)
recast_logomark_plate.framing: logomark centered, ample even negative space, no other elements
recast_logomark_plate.surface: matte printed page, faint paper grain

vintage_catalog_page_bw.name: Vintage black-and-white catalog photography
vintage_catalog_page_bw.prose: Soft duotone black-and-white studio photography in the manner of a 1960s/70s Scandinavian product catalog or auction-house plate: a single object floated in gentle, soft-light empty space, slight film grain, faint baseline shadow under the object, generous unornamented negative space, gentle midtones, no color anywhere. The subject is centered or slightly off-center, lit from above-camera with a long soft fall-off. Reads as a *page from a vintage product catalog, photographed* — never glossy, never retouched, never high-contrast.
vintage_catalog_page_bw.lighting: soft top, long fall-off, slight backlight separation
vintage_catalog_page_bw.palette: duotone black + warm-white paper, no color
vintage_catalog_page_bw.post: fine film grain, gentle midtones, no clipping
vintage_catalog_page_bw.framing: single object centered, generous baseline negative space, faint floor shadow

modernist_editorial_poster.name: Modernist editorial / album-cover poster
modernist_editorial_poster.prose: A photograph of a contemporary modernist editorial poster or album cover — dominant typography (often a single word, set tight) anchors the composition; one accent color carries the page; layout is grid-derived, asymmetric, considered. Faint paper grain, slight uneven inking, the object-quality of a printed thing rather than a digital flat. Photographed in flat studio light against #FAFAFA.
